comment: PRE-CONFIGURED agent-config.json for unattended-access deployment. Copy to the agent config dir (%APPDATA%/BetterDesk/agent/agent-config.json on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/BetterDesk/agent/agent-config.json on macOS, ~/.config/BetterDesk/agent/agent-config.json on Linux) and fill in server_address + api_key before first launch. The agent will auto-register, show as ONLINE in the web console, and accept unattended sessions using unattended_password.
